candidates.description: This feature vector represents traditional Irish given names, surnames, and associated cultural or geographic terms.
This vector represents three-digit numerical values, often associated with measurements, codes, or quantities.
This feature activates for proper nouns and common nouns representing formal institutions, organizations, and public establishments.
This feature vector represents currency units and related prefix or root forms.
This vector represents words containing or related to the root string "form" across various languages and affixes.
This vector represents concepts relating to actuality, worldly existence, and tangible reality.
This vector represents the concept of importance, dominance, or being primary and principal across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the letter sequence "or" or variants thereof.
This vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes, primarily in Romance languages, associated with manner or process.
This feature vector represents linguistic morphemes and roots related to activity, activation, and the concept of being active across multiple languages.
